user.title: Clean Energy
user.description: Watches every cumulative energy sensor for impossible jumps. Set the maximum realistic power draw for any single sensor; individual sensors can be given a lower one later. When a spike is caught you'll be asked whether to monitor that sensor, or you can add one any time with the `clean_energy.monitor_sensor` action. Each monitored sensor gets a parallel (Clean) sensor; the original is never modified.

confirm.title: Spike detected: {name}
confirm.description:
A suspicious spike was detected on **{entity_id}**: {spike_from} → {spike_to} {spike_unit} (implied {implied_power_kw} kW).

Monitor this sensor? Clean Energy will create a parallel (Clean) sensor that leaves out impossible jumps, including ones already in its history.

abort.already_configured: Clean Energy is already set up
abort.not_energy_sensor: This entity is not a total_increasing energy sensor

error.not_energy_sensor: This entity is not a total_increasing energy sensor

sensor.title: Clean sensor options
sensor.description: Maximum realistic power draw for **{entity_id}** alone. A jump implying more than this is treated as a glitch. Leave empty to use the global {hub_max_power_kw} kW, which has to suit whole-home meters; a much lower value suits small devices (a smart plug can't draw more than a few kW).

monitor_sensor.name: Monitor sensor
monitor_sensor.description: Manually start monitoring an energy sensor for spike correction, without waiting for the passive watcher to detect a spike.

entity_id.name: Energy sensor
entity_id.description: The total_increasing energy sensor to start monitoring.

rebuild_history.name: Rebuild history
rebuild_history.description: Re-derive a Clean sensor's long-term statistics from its source's, leaving out impossible jumps, and correct its current value to match. Use once on Clean sensors created before 0.4.0, whose history was copied with spikes included.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Optional. Energy (in the source's unit) known to be bogus in the source's current reading, for a spike that predates its recorded history. Overrides the value derived from history.

force.name: Force
force.description: Rebuild even though the Clean sensor has statistics older than any recorded for its source. Those older statistics are discarded.
